problem: Cross-browser assurance remained red on a blog page because transient ERR_CONNECTION_RESET events for core CSS/JS were retained even when the same assets later loaded successfully.
root_cause: The runner tracked failed core requests but did not correlate retry failures with later successful responses for the same resource path and type.
decision: A transient script/stylesheet failure is reconciled only when the same resource type+pathname subsequently returns a successful response in the same page. Non-transient failures and unrecovered assets remain hard failures.
prevention: Track successful script and stylesheet responses by type+pathname.
Suppress only transient retry failures with matching successful evidence.
Keep all visual, CLS, overflow and broken-image thresholds unchanged.
evidence: GitHub run 37210742038: five CSS/JS ERR_CONNECTION_RESET failures on /blog/aanzet-2026-emissieloze-trucks after final page render
